Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. upcoming.name: Ramayana
upcoming.synopsis: Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sam Pallavi. The film is produced by acclaimed filmmaker Namit Malhotra, whose Academy Award- wining visual effect company DNEG is behind films including The Odyssey, Dune, Interstellar, and Inception; directed by Nitesh Tiwari, whose film Dangal remains the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide; and scored by Academy Award winner Han Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Namit Malhotra’s Ramayana will be released globally in theaters on Diwali on November 6.

upcoming.name: Wild Horse Nine

Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) set out to Easter Island from Santiago, where they are stationed alongside their boss and bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Amongst the Island's iconic statues, as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students (Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas) threatens to send everyone’s trip
to this remote paradise sideways.
